name: Fawn
source:
Strengths - Kind, wise, gentle, can talk to animals
Weaknesses - Timid, possessive, hoarder, thinks he can talk to animals

Fawn lives in the forest that surrounds Aurelia Cavella, in a treehouse made of scrap and rubbish he scavenged himself. 

He loves animals and spends a lot of his time looking after them. For some unknown reason, he left his home as a child and hasn't seen a single person since.

He named himself after his favorite animal, forgetting the original name his parents gave him.

[From the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gabmag/the-divine-speaker-a-fantasy-bl-yaoi-gay-visual-no]Kickstarter campaign[/url]]

[spoiler]His original name was Aden.[/spoiler]
